data.name: Scintillating Aura
data.description: A great wyrm crystal dragon radiates an aura of scintillating color from its jeweled scales to a radius of 60 feet.  All within this area must make a DC %1 Will save each round to avoid being stunned (if the victim has 15 or fewer Hit Dice) or confused (if the victim has more than 15 Hit Dice) for 1 round.  This is a mind-affecting effect.  The dragon can activate or suppress this aura as a free action.|BreathWeaponDC
